verdict.rationale: Qodo, a code review platform, documents an official MCP server for its Agentic Toolbox. It is meant for connecting Qodo-managed skills to remote or custom agents, workflows, or applications, and exposes capabilities such as retrieving and resolving review findings. The probe confirms a dedicated MCP documentation page. Missing for 10: detailed setup/auth and full tool-list documentation in the evidence, independent or hands-on corroboration of MCP usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Use MCP when you want to connect Qodo Agentic Toolbox managed skills to a remote or custom agent, workflow, or application.
official MCP server documented at https://docs.qodo.ai/agentic-toolbox/mcp
